unit.title: Reading CVC Words and Simple Sentences

lesson.title: Review Day: Words, Sounds, and Our First Sentences
lesson.subject: ela

contentBlocks.text: This week you read short-A words, met short I, learned the digraph 'sh', and read full sentences! Today is review day — practice, not new learning.
Let's read a mix of everything: some short-A words, some short-I words, an 'sh' word, and a full sentence. Which felt easiest this week? Which would you like more practice with?
You made huge progress this week — from single words to whole sentences! Next week, we'll keep building your reading skills.

objectives: Demonstrate all skills practiced this week — short-A words, short-I words, the 'sh' digraph, and sentence reading — in one cumulative activity
Self-identify which skill feels most secure and which needs more practice
materialsNeeded: This week's four worksheets, if kept, for a quick flip-back review
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Read a mixed set of this week's words together: cat, sit, fish, ship.
2. Read both sentences from yesterday once more.
3. Ask which part of the week felt easiest and which felt hardest.
4. Move to the worksheet: complete the mixed review.
5. Praise effort and progress across the whole week, not just today's performance.
6. Close by previewing that next week continues building reading skills.
differentiationTips: Struggling: spend extra time on whichever single skill felt hardest, rather than requiring equal practice across all four
Ready for more: ask the child to write their own short sentence using two or more of this week's words
For a child who enjoys reading aloud, let them 'perform' both sentences from Day 4 one more time
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a review/recall activity — there is no single right/wrong answer. Note which of the week's skills the child recalled confidently vs. needed prompting for, to guide next week's pacing.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: A dedicated review day after a full week of new phonics patterns matches the platform's established pacing pattern (see every K-unit and the Math 1 unit's own Day 5 review lessons) — consolidation before adding more content is essential.

worksheet.title: Review Day: Words, Sounds, and Sentences
